text:
Wei Chen: hey folks — need final step copy + terminology confirmations for the guided onboarding checklist pages. we’re getting close to locking URLs + nav, but we keep seeing drift between Console labels and docs ("org" vs "project", "prod key" vs "production key"). can we align today so writers can freeze copy?

Wei Chen: specific Qs:
1) should we say “Project” everywhere (Console), or “Organization” (billing/keys are org-scoped?)
2) do we call it “Production API key” vs “Prod key” vs “Live key”? (support tickets mention confusion)
3) step titles: do we want sentence case? (Console seems Title Case in mocks)

Elliot Price: +1, please. also we need a canonical string for the thing the checklist tracks. is it per org, per project, or per API key? docs need to say “this checklist is per X” consistently.

Jean-Paul Laurent: i’m updating the checklist-linked pages right now and I keep rewriting the same 2 sentences. if we can settle a glossary, i’ll propagate through.

Marissa Cole: jumping in — from Console side we’re using “Project” as the top-level selector for everything onboarding (steps are tracked per project). org exists but mostly as “Org settings” / member management.

Marissa Cole: so docs should prefer Project when describing checklist progress.

Nikhil Sharma: +1. product intent: checklist is per *project* because that’s where the API key + usage analytics + quota context lives for a typical self-serve flow.

Elliot Price: ok but keys are currently created at org level right? (or at least they appear under org settings). that’s where confusion creeps in.

Kaitlyn Nguyen: keys are stored org-scoped in backend, but the UI entry point is inside a project context in Console. we tag keys with project_id for default association (and for checklist validation).

Kaitlyn Nguyen: recommendation: say “Create an API key for your project” (even if under the hood it’s org), and avoid “organization-scoped” language in onboarding docs.

Wei Chen: got it. can we get exact phrases for the docs page + step descriptions?

Kenji Nakamura: re copy, in the latest spec we were leaning:
- “Create an API key” (step title)
- description: “Create a test key for local development, then a production key before you ship.”
- CTA buttons: “Create key” / “View keys”

Dylan Brooks: from eng implementation: we’re literally labeling keys `test` and `prod` in the UI. so whatever we call it, we should mirror those labels to reduce mismatch.

Wei Chen: so do we call it “prod” or “production” in visible copy?

Nikhil Sharma: i’d say: user-facing copy = “Production key”. UI tag can be “prod” (small pill), but headings/descriptions should say “Production”. support conversations tend to use “production” not “prod”.

Marissa Cole: agree. Kenji — can we keep the pill as “Prod” but step text “Production API key”? (or is that too long?)

Kenji Nakamura: fine by me. step title can be “Create a production API key” (full words). description can mention the pill shows “Prod”.

Jean-Paul Laurent: can we standardize “API key” vs “key”? some pages say “Create a key” and others say “Create an API key”.

Elliot Price: docs preference: always “API key” on first mention; can shorten to “key” afterwards within same section.

Wei Chen: ok. also “org” vs “project”: docs currently have “Your org has multiple projects…” in a couple spots. should we keep org for multi-project explanation or stick to account/workspace?

Marissa Cole: we shouldn’t introduce “workspace” (we don’t use it). we use Org + Project. but onboarding flow should stay mostly within Project.

Nikhil Sharma: propose:
- Use “project” as the primary noun.
- Use “organization” only when needed (billing, members, ownership).
- Never say “account/workspace”.

Elliot Price: +1. we can add a tiny callout on the onboarding landing page: “Checklist progress is tracked per project.”

Wei Chen: cool. can we nail the step list with exact titles? (writers need to match Console 1:1)

Marissa Cole: current intended step titles (from PRD) are:
1. Create an API key
2. Make your first request
3. Try streaming
4. Handle errors & retries
5. Understand rate limits & quotas
6. View usage & latency in Console
7. Create a production API key
8. First production launch (review checklist)

Dylan Brooks: small note: “Handle errors & retries” step is mostly docs-only, no automatic validation. just making sure we don’t promise it’s detected.

Wei Chen: yep, docs will say “Recommended” vs “Validated” depending on step.

Jean-Paul Laurent: for 6, do we say “Usage dashboard” (Console nav label) or “View usage & latency in Console”?

Marissa Cole: Console nav item is “Usage”. the checklist step label in the UI mock is “Visit the Usage dashboard”.

Wei Chen: ok we’ll match “Usage dashboard”.

Elliot Price: please confirm capitalization style. Console step labels are Title Case right now?

Kenji Nakamura: in the latest component, they’re Title Case in the card view, sentence case in the detail panel. :shrug: i can align to sentence case everywhere if we want.

Nikhil Sharma: i’d rather keep it simple: sentence case for step titles (docs and Console). less shouty.

Marissa Cole: works. i’ll tell eng/design we’re standardizing on sentence case for step titles.

Dylan Brooks: ack. i can update the strings in the checklist config.

Wei Chen: awesome. last: “first production launch” vs “first prod launch” vs “go live”. what’s the canonical phrase?

Nikhil Sharma: “First production launch” is the official name.

Elliot Price: agree. we’ll use “go live” only as a verb in body copy.

Jean-Paul Laurent: can we get a final mini-glossary to paste into docs? (2-3 lines)

Kaitlyn Nguyen: suggested glossary snippet:
- Organization: top-level account for billing, members, and ownership.
- Project: a scoped area for API usage, settings, and onboarding progress.
- API key: credentials used to authenticate requests. Use a test key for development and a production key for live traffic.

Wei Chen: perfect. i’ll add that to the onboarding landing page and link it from the checklist doc.

Elliot Price: action items:
- Wei/JP update docs copy + headings with sentence case + “production API key” terminology.
- Marissa/Dylan align Console strings + step label “Usage dashboard”.
- Kaitlyn: confirm key labels in UI (“Test”/“Prod”) so docs can reference exactly.

Marissa Cole: :thumbsup: will follow up in the Console thread once strings are updated.

Dylan Brooks: :thumbsup: I’ll push a small PR to update the checklist config copy and ping @Wei Chen when merged.

Wei Chen: thanks all — this unblocks us. locking copy EOD unless anything changes.

Jean-Paul Laurent: amazing. i’ll do a final search/replace for “org” on the onboarding pages and only keep it where truly needed.

Elliot Price: pls also update the troubleshooting page headings if they mention “org key” anywhere. we should be consistent across everything.

Wei Chen: will do.
